items.raw_excerpt: Canada's last epishelf lake — made up of freshwater floating on saltwater — is gone, along with the unique ecosystem it supported, scientists confirm. Here's what made the lake special, and what it disappearance says about the transformation of the Arctic in a warming climate.
items.summary_en: Canada's last epishelf lake was a rare lake of fresh water floating on salt water. Scientists confirm it has disappeared. The warming Arctic took away the lake and the unique ecosystem that lived there.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다에서 마지막으로 남아 있던 엡시셸프 호수는 민물이 바닷물 위에 떠 있는 희귀한 호수였습니다. 과학자들은 이 호수가 완전히 사라졌다고 확인했습니다. 따뜻해진 북극 때문에 호수와 그곳의 독특한 생태계가 함께 사라졌습니다.
items.title_en: Canada's last epishelf lake is now gone

items.raw_excerpt: Nara Lokesh inaugurates two government schools renovated under the P4 model in Nellore: RSR High School in Stonehousepet and Devireddy Sarada High School in Mulapet.
items.summary_en: Nara Lokesh opened two government schools renovated under the P4 model in Nellore, India. The schools are RSR High School in Stonehousepet and Devireddy Sarada High School in Mulapet.

items.raw_excerpt: From bag checks and "heat maps" that show overcrowding to extra police officers, plus a safe area for women, here are the plans aimed at ensuring people's safety at Oktoberfest this year.
items.summary_en: Munich has released its safety plans for this year's Oktoberfest. There will be bag checks and more police officers. Special heat maps will show when the festival gets too crowded, and there will be a safe area for women.

items.raw_excerpt: Nine weeks is a long time to cover when both parents are working, especially if you don’t have grandparents nearby to help. Now the head of Austria’s Economic Chamber says six weeks of summer holidays would be enough.
items.summary_en: Nine weeks of summer holidays is a long time when both parents work and grandparents live far away. The head of Austria's Economic Chamber says six weeks would be enough. People are now discussing this idea.

items.title_en: Could Austria cut its summer school holidays from nine weeks to six?

items.raw_excerpt: A digital psychological intervention program to address the physical and emotional challenges of the transition to menopause has been created at the University of Coimbra (UC), accompanied by a study aimed at women between 40 and 60 years old.
items.summary_en: The University of Coimbra made a digital program to help women going through menopause. It addresses the physical and emotional challenges of the transition. A study will test it on women aged 40 to 60.

items.raw_excerpt: CTBC Financial Holding Co. subsidiary Taiwan Life Insurance Co. is expected to sign a NT$60 billion (US$1.89 billion) build-operate-transfer (BOT) contract with Taichung for a 45,000-seat domed baseball stadium in October, Mayor Lu Shiow-yen (盧秀燕) said Wednesday.

items.raw_excerpt: Dogs are part of everyday life in Germany – but the rules around leashes, noise and shared spaces can be surprisingly strict. Whether you own a dog or not, here’s how the law shapes what you see when you’re out and about.
items.summary_en: Dogs are a common part of everyday life in Germany. But the laws on leashes, noise, and shared spaces are sometimes surprisingly strict. These rules shape what people see on the streets, whether they own a dog or not.

items.raw_excerpt: At the Hardwick Estate in Derbyshire, competitors ran a 4.16-mile course every hour.
items.summary_en: Runners at Hardwick Estate in Derbyshire had to complete a 4.16-mile course every hour. Three women became the first all-women podium in UK ultra-marathon history. It was a test of strength and endurance over many hours.

items.raw_excerpt: If you find yourself in a great location, it'd be fair to say that you're in 'the middle of the butter eye'.
items.summary_en: Å være midt i smørøyet means to be in the best possible spot. The image comes from the melted butter sitting in the middle of a bowl of porridge. If you are in a great location, you are in the middle of the butter eye.

items.title_en: Norwegian phrase of the day: To be in the middle of the butter eye

items.raw_excerpt: Iceland’s first utility-scale wind farm has begun generating electricity at Vaðölduver, where Landsvirkjun plans 28 turbines by the end of 2027.

items.raw_excerpt: A 1700-year-old scrap of parchment containing verses from the Odyssey has been discovered in the library of Utrecht University. Researcher Mark de Kreij came across the fragile artefact two years ago while he was going through a collection of manuscripts that belonged to a German scientist. The torn fragment measures just 6.6cm by 7.7cm, roughly the size of a playing card, and contains a handful of verses from book 12 of Homer’s epic work. It describes the moment when Odysseus’s...
items.summary_en: A 1700-year-old piece of parchment with verses from the Odyssey was found in the library of Utrecht University. Researcher Mark de Kreij found it two years ago while going through old manuscripts. The torn scrap is only 6.6 cm by 7.7 cm, about the size of a playing card.
items.summary_ko: 우트레흐트 대학교 도서관에서 1700년 된, 오디세이아 구절이 적힌 양피지 조각이 발견됐습니다. 연구원 마르크 드 크레이는 2년 전 독일 과학자의 필사본 모음집을 조사하다가 이 자료를 찾았습니다. 찢어진 조각의 크기는 6.6cm x 7.7cm로 트럼프 카드만 한 크기입니다.
items.title_en: 1700-year-old scrap of The Odyssey found in Utrecht library

items.summary_en: A land document called the Foral de Mexia is still talked about in Goa, India. It was written about five hundred years ago. People say it still shapes how land is owned and shared today.
